mapper.select: SELECT a.user_account_id, a.member_key, a.username, a.fullname, a.email, a.password_hash, a.password_algo, a.is_active, r.role_name, r.delete_flag AS role_delete_flag FROM tbl_auth_user_account a LEFT JOIN tbl_dim_member_pseudonym m ON m.member_key = a.member_key LEFT JOIN tbl_dim_role r ON r.role_id = m.role_id WHERE a.username = #{username}

SELECT DISTINCT CASE WHEN organization_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'organization:' || organization_id::text WHEN customer_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'customer:' || customer_id::text WHEN project_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'project:' || project_id::text WHEN repository_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'repository:' || repository_id::text ELSE 'role:' || role_id::text END AS scope FROM tbl_auth_member_access_scope WHERE member_key = #{memberKey} AND active_flag = TRUE ORDER BY scope
